subject: Kickoff: Hierarchical Visual Foresight for long-horizon planning
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kicking off the HVF workstream in vision. The capability: self-supervised long-horizon task learning via visual subgoal generation - instead of planning pixel-by-pixel to a distant goal, HVF generates intermediate visual subgoals and plans between them. For the robotics-simulation customers this is the difference between demos that reach across a table and demos that tidy a room.

The stack per the release: an SV2P video prediction model trained via tensor2tensor, a conditional VAE for subgoal generation, plus the temporal distance cost function (TDM) and the time-agnostic prediction (TAP) baseline. Evaluation runs through the meta_cem planner on maze environments at horizon 50.

Milestones: full pipeline repro (generate_data through meta_cem) by 3/13, our simulation-env port by 4/17, review 5/6.

Carmen leads research, Hyun the video model, Bilal training infra, Saoirse env integration. Staffing and compute from you by Friday?

Lucia
